I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened the SEV2 incident.

- **Cause:** The latest deploy, v2.3.1, was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also been unhealthy in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. A human approver signed off on the rollback before it ran. All three regions now run v2.3.0, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 is open as a SEV2 for checkout-api, and the on-call engineer has been paged. It covers the failure, the rollback and a follow-up to find the root cause before v2.3.1 is deployed again. My first attempt to create it timed out. I checked that no incident had been created before retrying, and the retry used the same key so it couldn't run twice. Only one incident exists.
